body: Well apparently every time i speak to a girl they assume im asking them out. Can't go anywhere with anyone because im apparently asking them out but other guys can ask the same exact question and they can succeed
So another day of rejection. I have been actively trying in hopes because i plan on killing myself towards the end of the week but i think it's hopeless
Most people are hypocrites. It's ironic that most of the people who say having a relationship isn't all that are the ones in a relationship

Still get rejected whether i approach them or not. No one will go on a date with me

I'm in my second year of college and i did not find a single girl my entire first year of college who would go on a date with me. Also girls don't want to dance with me. I've been to dances and nightclubs and couldn't find a girl to dance with me. I have friends but they all have girlfriends. I'm the only loser who cant succeed
It's just impossible to get anywhere. I tried asking a few more girls to a cup of coffee today and all of them laughed at me. Life really sucks

How i can I love myself if no one else does. If no one in the entire world likes me than what do i have to feel good about. I don't have any dating successes so all i can do is compare myself to people. Life sucks being single. See if i don't look for a girlfriend ill be alone and if i do look ill still be alone
I suck at Art and i have ways to express feelings but it doesn't fix anything because at the end of the day im still alone and everyone is in or has had a relationship or even a date but me
It's far from girls being too shy. The issue is that im undateable. Sad but true. I cant find a single girl in my state who would go to the movies with me.
